definitions.explanation: Something that doesn't count or is not accepted.

examples.japanese: {砂糖|さとう}{無|な}しでお{願|ねが}いします。

examples.english: That doesn't count / That's not valid.

notes:
Often used as a suffix to mean "without ~" or "~-less."

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜{無|な}し (without ~, ~-less)
・{砂糖|さとう}{無|な}し (no sugar)
・{氷|こおり}{無|な}し (no ice)
・{問題|もんだい}{無|な}し (no problem)
・{予約|よやく}{無|な}し (without reservation)

USAGE NOTES:
・{無|な}しにする (to cancel, to call off)
・それは{無|な}しだ (that doesn't count)
・{無|な}しで (without)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{無|む}い (not having - classical/formal)
・〜ない (without - adjective form)
・{抜|ぬ}き (without, excluding)

NOTE:
Distinguish from {梨|なし} (pear) which is a homophone.
